keySentence: A little pig met new friends on the farm.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: It was afternoon now. The five friends sat under a tree. They shared sweet red apples. Wooly told a silly joke. Daisy showed off her spots. Gigi sang a goose song. Pip laughed for the first time. A little pig met new friends on the farm.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: That afternoon, the five animals sat together under a wide oak tree at the edge of the green field. The leaves above made soft shadows on the ground. They shared crisp red apples, told silly jokes about turnips and tractors, and watched yellow butterflies sail past. Wooly told a story about losing her wool to a cheeky breeze. Daisy made everyone laugh with her funny mooing impressions. Gigi taught Pip how to say "hello" in goose-honk. Pip leaned back against Wooly's soft wool and laughed for the first time since leaving home far away. A little pig met new friends on the farm, and a new family began to form right there under the old oak tree.
facts.Word cards: pig = 돼지 / farm = 농장 / meet = 만나다 / welcome = 환영하다
